name: Wall Sit
research: 90/90 hold (ACE: thighs parallel, knees over ankles, back + head on the wall). Ankle L (0.14,-0.30,0.074); shin vertical -> knee (0.14,-0.30,0.524); thigh level -> hip L (0.11,0.15,0.524); hip-ankle 0.64 m = 90 deg knee. Pelvis joint = hip centre + (0,0.051,-0.003) = (0,0.201,0.521). Wall block 1.2 x 0.2 x 1.8 m, front face at y 0.29: buttocks ~0.12-0.14 behind the hip joint (y ~0.27-0.29) and upper back ~0.08 behind the pelvis joint (y ~0.28) - estimates, so measure the back gap and slide the wall (loc y) to -0.01..+0.03 m. Arms hang (elev 10, plane 15 so the hands stay off the wall), hands at z ~0.40 beside the thighs. Sources: ACE wall squat; Straub & Powers 2024 (upright trunk + vertical tibia); Marchetti 2016 PMC4967668 (quads peak ~90 deg). Facts and checks: research/wall_sit.json.
